verdict.summary: The no-change sample retention is correctly class-scoped, window-bounded, and subordinate to both absolute ceiling dimensions. Admission occurs only after the existing selection has been clamped, accounts for the existing ledger envelope and each added record's conservative serialized-size estimate, stops at the first non-fitting newest-first candidate, and cannot evict an already selected record. The self-tests are non-vacuous and cover the motivating shortfall, exact sample cap, class isolation, distribution evidence path, full-ceiling behavior, record and byte headroom, newest-first ordering, no size-based cherry-picking, and the zero-limit slice edge case. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
